summary: The PR correctly implements cycle-safe role expansion and cycle detection as specified in Ticket T06, preserving legacy behavior and passing all tests.
key_findings: expand_roles uses a visited set to prevent infinite loops during traversal, satisfying Req 1.
detect_role_cycle uses DFS with state tracking (0=unvisited, 1=visiting, 2=visited) to correctly identify and raise ValueError on cycles, satisfying Req 2.
Legacy function normalize_roles remains unchanged and its test passes.
